name: reentrancy-cross-function
description: Classic cross-function reentrancy — CEI violation in withdraw()

ground_truth.title: Cross-function reentrancy in withdraw() via missing CEI pattern
ground_truth.root_cause: ETH transfer occurs before balance state update in withdraw()
ground_truth.violated_invariant: user balance must reflect their actual withdrawable ETH at all times
ground_truth.failure_predicate: attacker can withdraw more ETH than deposited by re-entering transfer() during withdraw()'s external call
attack_path: 3. VulnerableBank sends 1 ETH to attacker (external call)
5. balances[attacker] is still 1 ETH (not yet decremented) — transfer succeeds
6. withdraw() continues: balances[attacker] -= 1 ETH → now underflows or zeroes
7. Attacker has received 1 ETH AND transferred 1 ETH worth of credit to another account

economic_impact.max_extractable: up to contract's entire ETH balance
